preview.orzo.title: Lemon orzo with golden zucchini
preview.orzo.body: Bright lemon, a little parmesan, and one pan. An easy favourite for the evenings in between.
preview.orzo.step1: Slice the zucchini. In a lightly oiled pan, cook until golden on both sides.
preview.orzo.step2: Stir in the orzo and stock. Simmer gently, stirring often, until the pasta is tender. Add a splash of water if needed.
preview.orzo.step3: Take off the heat. Fold in the parmesan, lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice. Season to taste and serve.
preview.toast.title: Tomatoes on sourdough
preview.toast.body: Ripe tomatoes, crisp toast, and the good olive oil.
preview.toast.step1: Toast the bread until crisp. Chop the tomatoes and toss with the olive oil.
preview.toast.step2: Spoon the tomatoes onto the toast. Season to taste and serve straight away.
preview.rice.title: Miso mushrooms & rice
preview.rice.body: Deeply savoury mushrooms. A bowl to settle into.
preview.rice.step1: Cook the rice in water according to the packet instructions. Slice the mushrooms.
preview.rice.step2: Sear the mushrooms in a lightly oiled pan. Loosen the miso with a little warm water, stir it through, and serve over the rice.

problem.import.too_large: That page is too large to read.
problem.import.too_many_at_once: That's more recipes than one request brings over. Choose fewer.
problem.intake.not_found: That recipe draft doesn't exist any more, or it didn't fail.
problem.import.unknown_source_kind: Culina can't read that kind of app yet.
problem.import.unreachable_address: That address can't be fetched. It has to be an ordinary public web page.
problem.planning.entry_not_found: That planned meal isn't there any more.
problem.planning.invalid_position: That isn't a place in the day a meal can go.
problem.planning.invalid_range: A plan is read one week at a time.

problem.recipes.image_unreadable: Culina can't read that file as an image. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
problem.recipes.incompatible_units: Those amounts are in units that can't be added together.
problem.recipes.ingredient_in_use: A step still uses that ingredient. Take it off the step first.
problem.recipes.invalid_description: A description can be at most 2000 characters.
problem.recipes.invalid_duration: A time must be between zero and one week.
problem.recipes.invalid_group_name: A group of ingredients can be named in at most 80 characters.
problem.recipes.invalid_ingredient_name: An ingredient needs a name of at most 120 characters.
problem.recipes.invalid_ingredient_note: A note on an ingredient can be at most 200 characters.
problem.recipes.invalid_language: A recipe is written in English or German.
problem.recipes.invalid_quantity: An amount must be greater than zero.
problem.recipes.invalid_step_text: A step needs text of at most 4000 characters.
problem.recipes.invalid_step_title: A step's title names it in at most 120 characters. The instruction goes in the step.
problem.recipes.invalid_tag: A tag is a word or two – at most 40 characters.
problem.recipes.invalid_title: A recipe needs a title of at most 200 characters.
problem.recipes.invalid_unit: A unit is a short word like 'g', 'tbsp' or 'pinch' – at most 16 characters.
problem.recipes.invalid_yield: A recipe must make more than nothing and less than a thousand.
problem.recipes.invalid_yield_label: What a recipe makes is a word, not a sentence: at most 40 characters.
problem.recipes.not_found: That recipe doesn't exist any more. It may have been deleted.
problem.recipes.share_not_found: That link doesn't lead to a recipe. It may have been taken back.
problem.recipes.too_many_ingredients: A recipe can have at most 200 ingredients.
problem.recipes.too_many_steps: A recipe can have at most 100 steps.
problem.recipes.too_many_tags: A recipe can have at most 25 tags.
problem.recipes.unknown_ingredient_refer: A step refers to an ingredient that isn't in this recipe.

problem.request.malformed_if_match: Culina couldn't tell which version you were changing. Reload and try again.
problem.request.method_not_allowed: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.missing_parameter: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.no_such_endpoint: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.precondition_required: Culina couldn't tell which version you were changing. Reload and try again.
problem.request.rate_limited: That was a lot at once. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.request.rejected: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.repeated_parameter: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.unknown_parameter: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.unreadable: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.unsupported_media_type: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.version_mismatch: This changed since you opened it. Reload it and try again.
problem.searches.criteria_required: A saved search needs at least words, tags, a time limit or an order.
problem.searches.invalid_criteria: That isn't a filter the library can apply.
problem.searches.invalid_name: A saved search needs a name, and that one is too long.
problem.searches.name_taken: This household already has a saved search with that name.
problem.searches.not_found: That saved search doesn't exist any more.
problem.searches.too_many: A household can keep at most 100 saved searches.
problem.server.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, and quote the reference if it keeps happening.
problem.settings.invalid_value: That isn't a value this setting accepts.
problem.shopping.invalid_quantity: That isn't an amount that can be added up.
problem.shopping.unknown_section: That isn't a section of the shopping list. Reload the page and try again.
problem.shopping.item_not_found: That item isn't on the list any more.
problem.shopping.name_too_long: That name is too long for a shopping list.
problem.suggestions.invalid_limit: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.suggestions.missing_like_recipe: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.suggestions.too_many_impressions: Culina couldn't send that many recipes at once. Reload the page and try again.
problem.suggestions.unknown_purpose: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.
problem.suggestions.unknown_slot: That isn't a meal of the day Culina knows.
problem.users.email_already_used: That email address is already registered.
problem.users.invalid_display_name: A name is required, and it can be at most 80 characters.
problem.users.invalid_preference: That isn't a value this setting accepts.
problem.users.invalid_theme: That isn't a theme Culina knows.
problem.users.max_users_reached: This Culina has reached the number of accounts it allows.
problem.users.not_found: That person doesn't have an account here.
problem.users.registration_closed: This Culina isn't accepting new accounts.
problem.users.weak_password: A password must be at least 12 characters.
plan.shop.hint: A meal already on the list — or a recipe you added from its page — is not added twice.
plan.shop.done: Everything planned this week is on the shopping list.
plan.unplanned.stillOnList: {title} is off the plan. Its ingredients are still on the shopping list.
plan.unplanned.withdrawn: Its ingredients are off the shopping list.
cookbooks.takeOff.failed: That recipe could not be taken off the cookbook. Try again.
auth.join.member.title: You're already in {household}
auth.join.member.body: This invitation is for a household you belong to, so nothing changed — and the link still works for whoever it was meant for.
ai.models.seeConnection: No list from {provider} — see its connection above. Type the model name instead.
me.server.lead: How this instance runs: its database, what it trusts, and what it allows.
server.pinned: Set by {variable} in the server's environment — change it there.
server.readonly: These settings can't be saved from here: Culina's configuration directory isn't writable. Mount a volume at /data/config (or set Storage__ConfigPath to a writable directory) and restart it.
server.failed.title: The server settings didn't load
server.failed.body: Culina couldn't read how it is configured. Try again in a moment.
server.save.hint: Saving a change restarts Culina, which takes a second or two.
server.restarting: Culina is restarting with the new settings…
server.unchanged: Nothing changed — these are the settings Culina already runs with.
server.applied: Saved. Culina is running with the new settings.
server.stalled: Culina hasn't come back yet. Its log names the setting it couldn't start with. To undo it, set that setting's variable in the server's environment, or remove it from culina.json in the configuration directory.
server.signIn.hint: How the session cookie behaves, and how long a session lasts.
server.secure.hint: Send the session cookie over HTTPS only. Keep this on whenever Culina is reached through https://.
server.secure.http: This browser reached Culina over plain HTTP. With secure cookies on, nobody can sign in this way — open Culina through https:// first. Turning them off works only where the server's deployment allows it.
server.sessionDays.hint: Without being used. Every visit extends it.
server.renewAfterHours: Hours before a visit extends a session
server.renewAfterHours.hint: Extending on every request would cost a database write each time.
server.proxy.hint: Which proxies may tell Culina who a visitor really is. Without the right one, every visitor looks like the proxy and per-address limits protect nothing; trusting too much lets anyone forge their address.
server.proxy.direct: Requests reach Culina directly, not through a proxy.
server.proxy.trusted: Requests come through a proxy Culina trusts.
server.proxy.untrusted: Requests come through a proxy at {address}, which Culina doesn't trust yet.
server.networks.hint: CIDR ranges, for a proxy whose address changes — anything in a container network, like 172.18.0.0/16. Keep them as small as you can.
server.limits.hint: The most one visitor may ask for. The defaults suit a household; raise one only if people are being turned away.
server.limit.loginPerIpPerMinute: Sign-in attempts per minute, per address
server.limit.loginPerAccountPerMinute: Sign-in attempts per minute, per account
server.limit.registerPerIpPerHour: New accounts per hour, per address
server.limit.invitationPerIpPerHour: Invitations redeemed per hour, per address
server.limit.sharedRecipesPerIpPerMinute: Shared recipe views per minute, per address
server.limit.importsPerHour: Web page imports per hour, per person
server.limit.sourceRequestsPerHour: Requests to connected libraries per hour, per person
server.limit.assistantRequestsPerHour: Assistant requests per hour, per person
server.telemetry.hint: Where to send traces, metrics and logs over OpenTelemetry. Leave the address empty to export nothing; logs still go to the console.
server.database.hint: The PostgreSQL database Culina keeps everything in. Culina connects before saving, and refuses a database it couldn't run in.
server.database.name: Database name
server.database.username.hint: The role Culina connects as. Never a superuser.
server.database.password.keep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
server.database.requireSsl.hint: Turn this off only when the database is on the same private network and nothing else is.
server.database.move: Culina doesn't copy anything between databases. Pointing it at an empty one starts an empty instance.
setup.title: Set up Culina
setup.database.title: Connect a database
setup.database.intro: Culina keeps recipes, plans and accounts in PostgreSQL. Say how to reach it — Culina tries the connection before saving anything.
setup.server.title: How people reach Culina
setup.server.intro: Two settings depend on how this server is put on the network. Everything else has defaults that suit a household, and can be changed later under Settings → Server.
setup.account.title: Create your account
setup.account.intro: The first account administers this instance: it decides who else may join, and can change these settings later.
setup.unreadable: Culina couldn't read its settings. Check that the server is running, then try again.
problem.settings.not_writable: These settings can't be saved: Culina's configuration directory isn't writable.
problem.settings.database_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the host and the port, and that the database server is running.
problem.settings.database_unsuitable: Culina can't run in that database yet.

import.held.hint: Nothing was brought over for these. Tick the ones you want anyway.

editor.tags.suggested: This recipe could also be tagged
search.shelf.behind: A cookbook cannot ask for {words}; the rest comes along.
shopping.source.other: Added by hand or from elsewhere
shopping.separate: The same thing in units that can't be added up. Keep the line you need and remove the others.
editor.stepDuration.hint: Cook mode can start this timer for you.
plan.recipe.title: Plan “{title}”
plan.recipe.failed: This recipe couldn't be added to the plan.
recipe.delete.title: Delete {title}?
recipe.delete.body: It comes off the week and out of every cookbook, and a shared link stops working. Its cooking history, notes and photos go with it.
household.switch.heading: Your households
household.new.title: New household
household.new.name: Name
household.inherit.title: Inherited recipes
household.inherit.body: A household that inherits another sees every recipe that one sees. Its members can cook, plan and shop for those recipes, but only change them in the household they belong to.
recipe.inherited.note: From {household}. You can cook, plan and shop for it here, but only {household} can change it.
recipe.inherited.unknown: From another household. You can cook, plan and shop for it here, but only the household it belongs to can change it.
editor.inherited.title: This recipe can't be changed here
problem.households.inheritance_cycle: That household already sees this one's recipes, so this one can't inherit from it.
household.heirs.title: Households that see these recipes
recipe.copy.done: Copied. This one is yours to change.
recipe.diet.why: Search only presumed it: nothing in the ingredients says otherwise, but nobody has said so either. Your answer is kept as a tag.
recipe.diet.failed: The answer could not be saved.
shopping.move.heading: Belongs under
notes.unreadable: Your note could not be read, so it is not shown here.
auth.reset.title: Set a new password
auth.reset.intro: Culina doesn't send emails, so use one of the recovery codes you saved. If you have none, ask the person who runs this Culina for a reset code.
auth.reset.failed: That email address and recovery code don't match. A code works once, and a reset code from the administrator only for a day.
auth.reset.codeHint: Looks like ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS. Capitals and dashes don't matter.
me.security.lead: Your password, where you're signed in, and a way back in if you forget it.
me.password.title: Change password
me.password.body: Every other device you're signed in on will be signed out. This one stays signed in.
me.password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
me.recovery.title: Recovery codes
me.recovery.body: Culina can't email you a reset link. These codes are how you get back in if you forget your password — keep them somewhere safe, away from this device.
me.recovery.none: You don't have any recovery codes yet.
me.recovery.once: Each code works once. They're only shown now — save or print them before you leave this page.
me.recovery.replaces: Your earlier codes will stop working.
me.recovery.fileHeading: Culina recovery codes for {origin}. Each one works once.
server.recovery.hint: Make a one-time reset code for an account on this Culina. Culina sends nothing, so pass it on yourself.
server.recovery.once: Shown only now. It works once, until {when}, on the “Forgot your password?” page.
problem.auth.invalid_recovery_code: That email address and recovery code don't match.
recipe.delete.restorable: For 30 days you can still restore it, with all of that, under Settings → Household.
trash.title: Recently deleted
trash.body: Recipes and cookbooks deleted in this household in the last 30 days. Anyone in the household can bring them back; after that they are gone for good.
trash.empty: Nothing has been deleted in the last 30 days.
trash.failed: The deleted items couldn't be loaded.
household.delete.hint: Only an owner can do this. Everyone in the household loses access straight away.
household.delete.title: Delete {name}?
household.delete.body: Everyone in it loses access at once, and its recipes, cookbooks and shopping list go with it. Households that inherit its recipes stop seeing them.
household.delete.restorable: For 30 days an owner can still restore it, with everything in it. After that it is gone for good.
household.deleted.title: Deleted households
household.deleted.body: Households you deleted as an owner. Restoring one brings back its members, recipes and cookbooks.
notFound.eyebrow: Not found · a recipe for it
notFound.page.title: Lost Page Soup
notFound.page.body: There's no page at this address. Here's how to get back to cooking.
notFound.recipe.title: Vanished Recipe Stew
notFound.recipe.body: This recipe isn't in your kitchen. It may have been deleted, or the link you followed is incomplete.

notAllowed.body: These settings change the kitchen for everyone, so only administrators can edit them. Ask yours if something needs a tweak.
auth.cold.title: Your session went cold
auth.cold.body: You were away a while, so Culina turned the stove off. Sign in to fire it back up, right where you left off.
auth.secret.title: This one's a family secret
auth.secret.body: Recipes in Culina stay in the kitchen they belong to. Sign in if you're family, and the link opens right away.
auth.join.confirm.body: Somebody sent you a link to their household. Join only if you know who it was: its members will see your name, and whatever you add while you're in it belongs to their kitchen.
me.olli.hint: Olli stays with you while you use Culina. Turn off movement for a quieter interface. Kept on this device; your system’s reduced motion preference is also respected.
cooking.pip.title: Kitchen companion
cooking.pip.failed: The floating window could not open. Keep cooking here and try again.
cooking.remote.hint: Next/Previous: steps. Play/Pause: timer. Controls vary by device.
cooking.remote.failed: Remote controls could not start. Try again from this button.
import.review.title: Review the recipe
import.review.hint: Compare the amounts and steps with the source before saving. You can correct the recipe in the editor next.
import.media.label: Screenshots or recipe photos
import.media.hint: Up to 8 JPG, PNG or WebP images. 10 MB per image, 40 MB in total. Keep all pages of one recipe together.
import.media.invalid: Choose up to 8 JPG, PNG or WebP images, no larger than 10 MB each and 40 MB together.
import.media.unavailable: Reading screenshots needs the recipe-reading AI capability. You can still paste the recipe text here.
import.media.tooLong: Shorten the source text and captions to 20,000 characters before asking the AI to read them.
import.share.failed: The shared recipe could not be opened. Share it again, or paste its text or link below.

import.intake.hint: Add a link, paste a caption, or choose recipe screenshots. Review everything before saving.
intake.title: Olli is bringing your recipe over
intake.continues: You can leave this page or close the app. Olli keeps working and saves your recipe before it is ready for review.
intake.notificationFailed: Notifications could not be enabled. You can always find the saved import here when you return.
intake.failedBody: The source and any written draft are kept here. You can return to the import and try again.
intake.missing: This import could not be loaded.
problem.RecipeIntake.QueueFull: Three imports are already running. Wait for one to finish.
problem.Push.InvalidSubscription: This device could not register for notifications.
problem.Push.TooManyDevices: Too many devices are registered for notifications.
import.intake.iphone: On iPhone, choose Copy link in Instagram, then paste the link here. Culina cannot appear in the iPhone share menu.
cooking.autoScroll.hint: Auto-scroll moves slowly through long steps and pauses at each end. Tap the recipe or scroll yourself to stop it.
problem.settings.insecure_cookies: Secure cookies can only be turned off when this server's deployment allows it. Open Culina through https:// instead.
server.maxSessionDays: Days a session lasts at most
server.maxSessionDays.hint: Counted from signing in, however often it is used. Then a fresh sign-in is needed.
problem.settings.proxy_network_too_wide: That proxy network is too wide to trust: every client in it could claim any address. Name your proxy's own network, no wider than a /8 for IPv4 or a /32 for IPv6, such as 172.16.0.0/12.
server.limit.archiveExportsPerHour: Archives taken per hour, per person
problem.settings.file_unreadable: These settings can't be saved: culina.json in Culina's configuration directory was changed by hand and can no longer be read. Correct or remove the file, then save again.
problem.settings.database_login_refused: The database server refused the user, the password or the database name.
problem.settings.database_tls_failed: Culina couldn't set up an encrypted connection with that server. Enable TLS on the database server, or turn off “Require TLS” if the database is on the same private network.
problem.settings.database_not_postgres: Something answered at that address, but not a PostgreSQL server Culina can use.
problem.settings.database_superuser: Culina has to connect as a role of its own, not as a superuser. Use the role that owns Culina's database.
problem.settings.database_password_requi: Enter the password again. The host, port, database name or user changed, and Culina only sends a stored password to the server it was saved for.
problem.settings.database_insecure_auth: The database server wants a sign-in method Culina doesn't use. Culina signs in only with SCRAM-SHA-256: set password_encryption to scram-sha-256, set the role's password again, and use scram-sha-256 in pg_hba.conf.
problem.assistance.api_key_required: Enter the key again. The address changed, and Culina only sends a stored key to the address it was saved for.
server.database.password.again: Enter the password again: Culina only sends the stored one to the server it was saved for.
ai.address.keyAgain: Changing the address means entering the key again: Culina only sends a stored key to the address it was saved for.
problem.import.source_needs_reconnecting: This connection's token can no longer be read. Disconnect it and connect it again.
import.url.waiting: This link hasn't been opened yet. Tap “{action}” to read it.

problem.request.invalid_parameter: Culina couldn't handle that request. Reload the page and try again.

nutrition.reason.spoonOfSolid: spoonful of a solid – too imprecise
nutrition.reason.volumeOfSolid: volume of a solid – too imprecise

problem.products.unknown: This household has not named that barcode yet.
problem.products.already_named: This household already named that barcode. Open it to change its name.

problem.products.invalid_ingredient: An ingredient name can have at most 200 characters.
problem.products.invalid_quantity: A quantity must be more than 0 and at most 9,999,999.
problem.products.invalid_unit: A unit is a short word such as g, ml or pack, and goes with a quantity.

problem.products.invalid_note: A note can have at most 500 characters.

nutrition.weight.title: How much does 1 {unit} of “{name}” weigh?
nutrition.weight.reach: Applies to all your recipes with “{name}” in {unit}.
nutrition.weight.invalid: Enter a weight above 0 and at most 10,000 grams.
nutrition.weight.doneRemoved: The weight for 1 {unit} of “{name}” is removed.

household.ingredients.body: What you have set for ingredients. It applies to every recipe of your household.

household.ingredients.empty: You can set ingredients in the nutrition breakdown of a recipe.
household.ingredients.failed: The ingredients could not be loaded.

ingredients.suggestions.empty: Nothing to tidy up: every ingredient has one name.

ingredients.merges.empty: No merges yet. When you merge or rename an ingredient, it shows up here.
ingredients.nutrition.title: Nutrition
problem.ingredients.invalid_name: An ingredient needs a name of at most 120 characters.

problem.ingredients.too_many_merges: A household can merge at most 1,000 ingredient names.

nutrition.package.name: Name
nutrition.package.needed: A name and the kilocalories are needed.
nutrition.package.listBody: What you typed from a label for foods the table does not have. Add one from an ingredient’s nutrition sheet.
nutrition.package.removed: “{name}” is removed; ingredients that used it count as before.
problem.nutrition.invalid_food: A food needs a name and its kilocalories per 100 g, and every value must fit in 100 g.
problem.cookbooks.order_mismatch: That order doesn't list exactly the recipes on this cookbook. Open it again and arrange what is there now.
cookbooks.arrange.title: Arrange recipes
cookbooks.arrange.intro: This is the order the cookbook reads in. Recipes you add later go last.
cookbooks.arrange.failed: The recipes on this cookbook couldn't be loaded.
cookbooks.arrange.changed: Somebody changed this cookbook meanwhile. This is its order now; arrange it again.
problem.cookbooks.invalid_cover: The cover has to be a recipe on this cookbook that has a photo.
cookbooks.cover.label: Cover
cookbooks.cover.hint: One photo for the whole cover, or the first photos on the shelf.
problem.auth.invalid_client: Culina does not know that kind of device.
connect.title: Connect to your kitchen
connect.intro: Culina runs on your own server. Enter the address you open it at in a browser.
connect.failed.address: That does not look like a server address. Try something like kitchen.example.com.
connect.failed.unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check it, and that this phone can reach the server.
connect.failed.notCulina: Something answered there, but it is not Culina.
connect.failed.notSetUp: This Culina is not set up yet. Finish setting it up in a browser first.
connect.failed.serverTooOld: This server runs an older Culina than this app understands. Ask whoever runs it to update it.
connect.failed.appTooOld: This server runs a newer Culina than this app understands. Update the app.
me.server.switchBody: Signs you out here and asks for another address.
error.backgrounded: This stopped while Culina was in the background. What arrived is kept; try again to finish it.
server.push.hint: The Culina apps for iPhone and Android can say when an import is ready, but only through a relay run by whoever publishes the apps: Apple and Google take notifications from nobody else. Naming one sends the words of each notification ("Your recipe is ready") to that service, never a recipe, a name or this server's address. Leave it empty and the apps get no notifications; browsers are not affected.
problem.push.relay_off: This server doesn't send notifications to the apps. An administrator can name a relay under Server.
problem.push.invalid_device: That device couldn't be registered for notifications.
shopping.meals.title: Meals and recipes on this list: {count}
shopping.meals.pastNote: This day has passed, but what it asked for stays on the list until you tick it off or remove it.
shopping.meals.withdraw.label: Take off the list: {title}
shopping.meals.withdrawn: What {title} still needed is off the list.
plan.recipe.alsoShop: Put it on the shopping list too
plan.recipe.doneListed: Added to {day} and to the shopping list.
plan.recipe.doneNotListed: Added to {day}, but it could not go on the shopping list.
cooked.title: Made it. Anything for next time?

match.countPlural=one: Take the unbought line off the list
match.countPlural=*: Take {count} unbought lines off the list

editor.stepDuration.spotted.label: Use {minutes} min as the timer of step {number}
recipe.stub.title: Only a title so far
recipe.stub.body: Add the ingredients and steps to cook from it.
import.photo.or: or a link to the recipe
shopping.sheet.onList: already on the list for this recipe
shopping.sheet.forMeal: Planned for {when}: the ingredients go on for that meal, for {servings}.
plan.recipe.alreadyListed: Its ingredients are already on the shopping list; they now count for this meal.
shopping.sheet.addsUp: already on the list; this adds to it
recipe.timesWarning.up: The times are for {count} — a fuller pan or tin may need longer.
editor.linkSpotted.hint: The steps name them. Linked, they show up in cook mode with the step, at the servings you cook.
notes.peek.add: Add a note for next time
notes.editor.hint: Only you see your notes. Put one in the step and everyone cooking it sees it.
shopping.quantity.label: How much {name}
shopping.merge.done: “{from}” is now “{to}”, here and in your recipes.
shopping.merge.apart: Their amounts do not add up, so the two lines stay apart.
recipe.stub.filled: Filled in. Check it over in the editor.
recipe.stub.fillHint: Fills this recipe in place: it stays on the plan, with your notes.
picker.createStub.hint: Just the name for now; fill it in later.
cookbooks.takeOff.label: Take {title} out of this cookbook
cookbooks.plan.title: Which one for the week?
plan.dishes.label: Dishes of this meal
plan.dishes.hint: Switch freely: each keeps its step.

match.countPlural=one: Plan the rest for later: {count} serving
match.countPlural=*: Plan the rest for later: {count} servings

plan.recipe.leftoversHint: The recipe makes more. It is cooked and bought once, for everything; the rest goes on the plan for lunch and adds nothing to the list.
tour.label: A tour of Culina
tour.capture.title: Get recipes in
tour.steps.title: Steps that help while cooking
tour.plan.title: Plan, then shop
tour.cook.title: Cook with your hands free
tips.steps.title: Add ingredients with @
tips.steps.mention: Type @ and the first few letters, say @oni for onions. The amount then shows up right in the step and changes with the servings.
tips.steps.more: Write waiting times in minutes and cook mode turns them into timers. And three short steps are easier to follow than one long one.
tips.cook.title: One step at a time
tips.cook.swipe: Swipe left for the next step.
tips.cook.keys: The arrow keys take you from step to step.
tips.cook.read: Tap the speaker below and I’ll read each step out to you, so you don’t have to keep looking at the screen.
tips.plan.title: Move meals around
tips.plan.drag: Hold a meal for a moment, then drag it to another day.
tips.plan.shop: Once the week looks right, one tap puts everything it needs on the shopping list. Nothing is added twice.
tips.shopping.title: Meal cancelled?
tips.shopping.meals: Open the meals at the top and tap “Take off the list”. The dish goes, ingredients and all.
tips.shopping.shared: If you share your household, you all see the same list, including what’s already in the basket.
me.help.tourBody: Olli shows you round in a minute, with everything to try: capturing, steps, planning, shopping and cooking.
me.help.tipsBody: Show the tips beside steps, cook mode, the week and the list once more.
tour.hello.title: Welcome
tour.hello.says: Hi, I’m Olli! Give me a minute and I’ll show you how your kitchen works here.
tour.loop.collect.what: All your recipes in one place, searchable by name or ingredient. Cookbooks keep them in order, and some fill up on their own.
tour.loop.plan.name: Plan
tour.loop.plan.what: Spread recipes over the week, for however many are eating.
tour.loop.shop.what: One tap puts what the week needs on the list, and your household sees it too.
tour.loop.cook.what: Step by step, with timers. Afterwards, jot down what you’d do differently, and round it goes again.
tour.capture.says: How does a recipe get in here? Pick a way and try it.
tour.capture.name: Just a name
tour.capture.later: Ingredients and steps can come later.
tour.capture.link.said: I read out the ingredients, amounts, steps and source for you.
tour.capture.photo.said: Works with a cookbook page or a handwritten card too.
tour.capture.name.said: A name is enough to plan it. Fill it in later.
tour.capture.link.what: Paste a link or text, from the web or a message.
tour.capture.photo.what: Photograph a page, and Culina reads it.
tour.capture.name.what: Just the name for now, for the idea you don’t want to forget.
tour.sample.title: Shakshuka
tour.steps.says: Now the important bit: good steps. Watch what an @ can do!
tour.steps.demo.label: Step 1
tour.steps.demo.onion.name: onions
tour.steps.demo.butter.name: butter
tour.steps.written.said: The amounts now sit in the step and scale along. Try the servings!
tour.steps.scaled.said: Exactly! Ingredients, steps and the shopping list always scale along.
tour.steps.rule.one.why: Start a new one when your hands do something new.
tour.steps.rule.short.why: So it fits one glance in cook mode.
tour.steps.rule.wait.why: Write “5 minutes” and cook mode offers a timer.
tour.plan.says: Put a recipe on a day, and I’ll write the shopping list.
tour.plan.empty: Empty for now. Plan a day and the list fills up.
tour.plan.listed.said: Everything the week needs is on the list, once. Got something at home? Take it off.
tour.plan.ticked.said: Ticked! Your household sees it straight away.
tour.cook.says: When you cook, I’m your kitchen helper. Try the timer and reading aloud!
tour.cook.step.two: Add the pepper and tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
tour.cook.step.three: Make four hollows, crack in the eggs and cover for 6 minutes until set.
tour.cook.made.what: A note and a photo for next time, so the recipe keeps getting better.
tour.cook.rang.said: Ding! Timers ring even when you’re elsewhere in Culina.
tour.cook.read.said: I read each new step aloud. In cook mode, turn it on with the speaker.
tour.cook.done.said: Afterwards, note what you’d change next time.
tour.cook.what: Swipe, or tap Next, to move on. The screen stays on.
tour.start.title: Let’s go
tour.start.says: That’s it! Where shall we start?
tour.start.paste.what: From a website or a message
tour.start.photo.what: From a cookbook or a recipe card
tour.start.idea.what: Describe a dish and get a draft to fill in
tour.start.write.what: Name, ingredients, steps, at your own pace
tour.start.again: You’ll find the tour any time in the account menu.
tour.progress.label: Parts of the tour
welcome.olli: Hi, I’m Olli, your kitchen helper.
tour.loop.picked.said: You’ll find these any time in the bar: at the bottom on a phone, at the top on a computer.
tour.capture.import.what: Bring your whole collection over from another recipe app, currently {apps}.
tour.capture.import.said: I bring a whole collection over in one go, into a cookbook named after the app.
tour.steps.written.watch: The amounts now sit in the step. Watch what more servings do:
tour.steps.doubled.said: Twice the servings, twice of everything: in the step and in the ingredients. Your turn!
plan.view.label: View
plan.days.title: Coming days
plan.earlier.title: Earlier this week
plan.jump.label: Jump to a date
me.devices.title: Signed in
me.devices.body: Every browser, app and agent that can use your account. Sign out anything you don't recognise.
me.agent.title: Connect an AI agent
me.agent.body: Give an AI assistant such as Claude Code its own token for your library, through Culina's MCP server. The token works only there, and you can sign it out above at any time.
me.agent.once: This token is shown only now. Copy it into your agent before you leave this page; if it gets lost, make a new one.
problem.agent.unknown_tool: The AI agent asked for something Culina can't do.
problem.agent.unknown_argument: The AI agent sent a detail Culina doesn't understand.
problem.agent.missing_argument: The AI agent left out a detail Culina needs.
problem.agent.invalid_argument: The AI agent sent a detail Culina can't use.
authorize.title: Let {client} into your Culina?
authorize.intro: {client} wants its AI agent to work in your account, through Culina's MCP server.
authorize.thisComputer: This app sends you back to a program on this computer, which any program here could pretend to be. Only allow it if you started connecting it here just now.
authorize.can: The agent will be able to read and change everything in your households: recipes, cookbooks, the meal plan and the shopping list. It can't see your password, your devices or your settings.
authorize.later: You can disconnect it at any time under Settings › Sign-in.
authorize.failed.title: This connection can't go ahead
authorize.failed.retry: Start connecting again from the app.
problem.oauth.invalid_request: The app sent an incomplete or malformed request.
problem.oauth.invalid_client: Culina can't tell which app is asking.
problem.oauth.invalid_redirect_uri: The app asked to send you somewhere it never registered, so Culina won't.
problem.oauth.invalid_client_metadata: The app registered itself in a way Culina doesn't accept.
problem.oauth.unsupported_response_type: The app asked for a kind of sign-in Culina doesn't offer.
problem.oauth.invalid_target: The app asked for access to something other than this Culina.
problem.oauth.invalid_grant: The connection code is no longer valid. Connect the app again.
problem.oauth.unsupported_grant_type: The app asked for a kind of access Culina doesn't offer.
problem.oauth.access_denied: You declined to connect this app.
problem.agent_authorizations.not_found: This connection request has expired or was already answered.
auth.link.title: Signing you in
auth.link.opening: Opening the link from your mail…
auth.link.failed.title: That link didn't work
auth.confirm.title: Confirming your address
auth.link.useLink: Email me a sign-in link instead
auth.link.ask.title: Sign in by email
auth.link.ask.intro: We'll mail you a link that signs you in without a password. It works once, for 15 minutes.
auth.link.sent.title: Check your inbox
auth.link.sent.body: If {email} has a Culina account, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it on this device within 15 minutes.
auth.reset.intro.mail: Enter the code from the mail we sent you, or one of the recovery codes you saved, and choose a new password.
auth.reset.ask.intro: We'll mail you a link to choose a new password. It works once, for one hour.
auth.reset.sent.title: Check your inbox
auth.reset.sent.body: If {email} has a Culina account, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works for one hour.
auth.register.confirm.title: Confirm your address
auth.register.confirm.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm the address is yours, and you're in. It works for 48 hours.
me.invite.email.hint: Culina sends the invitation to this address. It works for 14 days.
me.mail.lead: The account Culina sends mail from: address confirmations, sign-in links, password resets and invitations.
mail.account.hint: Your mail provider's SMTP server. Culina signs in to it to send, like a mail app would.
mail.enabled.hint: While on, new accounts confirm their address before they can sign in, and people can get sign-in and password links by mail.
mail.security.hint: What your provider asks for. STARTTLS on port 587 is the most common.
mail.username.hint: Often the sender's address. Leave it empty for a server that takes mail without signing in.
mail.password.hint: Many providers want an app password here, not your account's own.
mail.password.keep: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
mail.password.again: Enter the password again: it is only sent to the server it was saved for.
mail.sender.hint: Who the mail comes from, as inboxes show it.
mail.test.sent: Test mail sent to your address.
mail.state.sending: Mail is on. Links in it point to {address}.
mail.state.off: Mail is off. Nothing is sent, and recovery works with codes, as before.
mail.siteUrl.missing: Culina doesn't know its public address yet, so it can't put links in mail. Set Site__Url (such as https://culina.example.com) where Culina runs, and restart it.
mail.failed.title: The mail settings couldn't be loaded
mail.failed.body: Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
problem.auth.email_unconfirmed: Confirm your email address first: open the link we sent you. We've just sent it again.
problem.auth.invalid_link: That link doesn't work any more. Links work once and only for a while; ask for a new one.
problem.mail.incomplete: Mail can only be switched on with a server and a sender address.
problem.mail.site_url_required: Mail can only be switched on once Culina knows its public address. Set Site__Url first.
problem.mail.password_required: Enter the password again: it is only sent to the server it was saved for.
problem.mail.invalid_value: That isn't a value the mail account accepts.
problem.mail.send_failed: The mail couldn't be sent. Check the server, port, security and password, then try again.
